description_en: Call the DescribeCrTemplates operation to query YAML templates for Istio resources that are used in common scenarios in a service mesh
description_zh: 调用DescribeCrTemplates查询服务网格中常见使用场景下的Istio资源YAML模板
kebab_example: aliyun servicemesh describe-cr-templates --istio-version v1.18.0.160-gcc1f41cd-aliyun --kind VirtualService --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCrTemplates

parameters.help_en: The Istio version that the service mesh uses
parameters.name: istio_version

parameters.help_en:
The type of Istio resource for which you want to obtain common templates. Valid values:

- AuthorizationPolicy

- RequestAuthentication

- PeerAuthentication

- WorkloadGroup

- WorkloadEntry

- Sidecar

- EnvoyFilter

- ServiceEntry

- Gateway

- DestinationRule

- VirtualService
parameters.help_zh:
需要获取常见模板的istio资源类型，可用取值包括：

- AuthorizationPolicy
- RequestAuthentication
- PeerAuthentication
- WorkloadGroup
- WorkloadEntry
- Sidecar
- EnvoyFilter
- ServiceEntry
- Gateway
- DestinationRule
- VirtualService
parameters.name: kind
